Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: What personal information RISE CREW collects when you create and use an account on this website, why, and how we handle it.

purpose.title: Why we use your information
purpose.intro: RISE CREW (“the club”) is responsible for the personal information collected on this website. We use it only for the purposes below, and if a purpose changes we will tell you first and ask for your consent.

account.label: Account management
account.body: Confirming who has signed up, signing you in, managing roles (guest, member, operator, admin), and limiting the use of accounts that cause problems.

community.label: Community use
community.body: Showing content that only signed-in people can see, and giving members features such as posting and replying.

recruit.label: Recruitment notices
recruit.body: Emailing recruitment dates and application guides, only to people who agreed to receive recruitment emails.

items.title: What we collect
items.intro: We ask for the information below when you sign up. We do not collect phone numbers or student IDs.

email.label: Email
email.body: Required. Taken from your Google account if you sign in with Google, or the address you enter if you sign up by email. Signing up by email also takes a password, stored only as a one-way hash that cannot be turned back into the password, so operators and admins cannot see it either.

name.label: Last name, first name
name.body: Required. Saved exactly as you type it, and never translated.

occupation.label: What you do now
occupation.body: Required. One of undergraduate, graduate student, alumni or employed, founder, or other.

school.label: School, major
school.body: Asked only if you choose undergraduate or graduate student, and required then.

affiliation.label: Affiliation
affiliation.body: Optional. If you are not a student, you can give the name of a company or team, for example.

age14.label: Confirmation that you are 14 or older
age14.body: Required. Recorded with the time you confirmed and the version of this policy.

privacy.label: Consent to collect and use personal information
privacy.body: Required. Recorded with the time you agreed and the version of this policy.

recruit.label: Consent to recruitment emails
recruit.body: Optional. Whether you agreed is recorded with the time and the version of this policy.

items.passive: If you sign in with Google, Supabase also stores the basic profile Google shares (display name, profile picture URL, account identifier and the like) with your sign-in details. Supabase and Vercel keep access logs automatically (IP address, browser, and times), and Supabase’s sign-in logs also include your account email and account identifier. These logs are held under each company’s own policy.
items.cookies: This site stores cookies in your browser. While you are signed in, a cookie keeps you signed in. When the language you view the site in differs from your browser’s (for example after you switch language), a cookie remembers that language, whether or not you are signed in. We do not use cookies for advertising or for tracking visits. You can block cookies in your browser settings, but then you cannot stay signed in and your language choice is not remembered.

retention.title: How long we keep it, and how we destroy it
retention.keep: We keep your information until you delete your account.
retention.unfinished: If you never finish the sign-up form, the account is deleted automatically 7 days after it was created, along with its sign-in details such as your email address, password hash and the basic profile Google shared.
retention.delete: When you delete your account on My page, your account and sign-up information are deleted right away, along with the record of your consents. Copies of account emails (sign-up confirmation and password reset: your address and a code that has already expired) in the Gmail account that sent them are deleted automatically within 30 days. Access logs that the companies keep automatically are held under each company’s own policy.
retention.destroy: When the retention period ends or there is a reason to delete information, we destroy it without delay. We handle personal information only in electronic form and destroy it by deleting it from the database. We do not keep it on paper or in separate files. Anything left in a company’s backups is gone when that backup’s retention period ends.

processors.title: Who processes it for us
processors.intro: We rely on the companies below to run the website. What goes outside South Korea is set out in the next section.

supabase.label: Supabase
supabase.body: The database (where sign-up information is stored) and sign-in (account verification)

google.label: Google
google.body: Google sign-in (confirming who you are through your Google account) and account emails. For now, a RISE CREW Gmail account sends sign-up confirmation and password reset emails. The recipient address and the one-time code pass through Google, and the sent copy is deleted automatically within 30 days.

transfer.title: Transfers outside South Korea
transfer.intro: The database that stores sign-up information is in South Korea (Seoul), but some personal information goes outside the country as set out below, as far as running the service requires. We disclose this in this policy under Article 28-8(1)(3) of the Personal Information Protection Act. It is sent over encrypted connections whenever you sign up, sign in or use the site.

supabase.label: Supabase Pte. Ltd. (privacy@supabase.com)
supabase.country: The database is in South Korea (Seoul). Running and supporting the service may involve processing in Singapore and other countries.
supabase.items: Sign-up information, sign-in details (including the password hash), consent records, access logs
supabase.purpose: Running the database and sign-in. Kept until you delete your account; access logs follow the company’s own policy.

vercel.label: Vercel Inc. (privacy@vercel.com)
vercel.country: South Korea (where the website’s server runs, Seoul); United States (where the company is based; access logs follow its own policy)
vercel.items: What passes through while you use the site (sign-in cookies, sign-up information you enter or edit) and access logs
vercel.purpose: Running the website. What passes through is used for processing and not stored; access logs follow the company’s own policy.

google.label: Google LLC (policies.google.com/privacy)
google.country: The United States and other countries where Google runs servers
google.items: Account details used for Google sign-in; the recipient address and one-time code in account emails
google.purpose: Google sign-in and sending account emails. Sent copies are deleted within 30 days; anything else follows the company’s own policy.

transfer.refuse: If you do not want this transfer, do not create an account, or delete yours on My page. You then cannot use features that need signing in, but public pages stay open without an account.

visibility.title: Who can see it

self.label: You
self.body: You see your own sign-up information on My page. You cannot see anyone else’s.

staff.label: Operators and admins
staff.body: They see all sign-up information (name, email, what you do now, school, major and affiliation, and whether you agreed to recruitment emails) of people who finished signing up, on the member management screen. They do not see accounts that never finished the sign-up form. They look at it only to manage members and, for people who agreed, to send recruitment notices.

admin.label: Website administrator
admin.body: As the person handling the data, the website administrator can see the sign-in details and sign-up information of every account in the Supabase dashboard, including accounts that never finished the sign-up form. They look at it only when running the site or handling a deletion request requires it.

visibility.outro: The member management screen has no way to download the member list as a file. The club does not give personal information to anyone outside the companies and people named above.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.manage: On <me>My page</me> you can view your sign-up information at any time, edit it, and delete it by deleting your account. You can change your choice about recruitment emails there too.
rights.decline: You may decline to consent to the collection and use of your information, but without the required items you cannot sign up.
rights.unfinished: If you signed in but did not finish the sign-up form, you cannot reach My page, but the account is deleted automatically 7 days after it was created. To have it deleted sooner, or for any other request, email <mail>risecrew4@gmail.com</mail>.

under14.title: People under 14
under14.body: People under 14 cannot sign up. Under the Personal Information Protection Act, handling the information of a child under 14 needs the consent of a legal guardian, so sign-up is limited to people 14 or older, and we ask you to confirm it when you sign up. If we find that an account belongs to someone under 14, we delete it.

security.title: How we keep it safe
security.intro: We take the measures below to protect personal information.

managerial.label: Administrative
managerial.body: Only operators, admins and the website administrator can see personal information. The Google account that sends account emails uses two-step verification.

technical.label: Technical
technical.body: Database access rules limit what each role can see. Information travelling to and from the site uses encrypted connections (HTTPS), and Supabase stores the database encrypted. Passwords are stored only as hashes and are never emailed.

physical.label: Physical
physical.body: The club runs no servers of its own and keeps no paper lists. Personal information is held in the facilities of the companies above.

officer.title: Privacy officer
officer.intro: For questions about personal information, requests to view, correct or delete it, and complaints, contact:
officer.note: The president changes with each cohort, so we give the position instead of a name.

version.title: Effective date and version
version.body: This policy applies from the date below. When it changes, we publish the new version on this page, and the version you agreed to is kept in your consent record.
